title: Urological Supply Program Enrollment Register Standard: One Open Enrollment per Patient
content:
A patient holds at most 1 Urological Supply Program enrollment that is not cancelled. A change of catheter type is a program switch on the same enrollment, not a second enrollment. No enrollment is opened while another enrollment of the patient is enrolled-pending, active or on hold.

## Basis of the standard

- **Subject:** opening a new enrollment in the Urological Supply Program for a patient.
- **Object:** the patient. Every enrollment the patient already holds in the program is counted, whatever catheter program it is in.
- **Evidence:** the enrollment records on file for that patient and the status each record shows. The status is read from the system record before the new enrollment is opened; a statement by the caller about the patient's enrollments does not replace the record.
- **Limit:** 1 enrollment that is not cancelled, per patient.

## Status of an existing enrollment of the same patient

| Existing enrollment status | Effect under this standard |
|---|---|
| enrolled-pending | no new enrollment is opened |
| active | no new enrollment is opened |
| on hold | no new enrollment is opened |
| cancelled | not counted; this standard does not prevent a new enrollment |
| no enrollment on file | this standard does not prevent a new enrollment |

## Points of judgement

- A patient enrolled in the Straight Intermittent Catheter Program (A4351) whose order changes to a coudé tip stays on the same enrollment; the change of catheter type is recorded as a program switch on it.
- A hypothetical patient with one cancelled enrollment and one on-hold enrollment cannot have a third opened: the on-hold enrollment is not cancelled and already uses the limit of 1.
- A hypothetical patient whose only earlier enrollment was cancelled holds 0 enrollments that are not cancelled, so the limit of 1 is not reached by that earlier record.
